result.summary: The image shows a wide urban street with a high-visibility continental crosswalk and a well-maintained sidewalk lined with mature trees. While pedestrian signals and curb ramps are present, the multi-lane configuration and parked cars near the crossing create potential visibility and exposure risks for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the curb near the crosswalk may obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians entering the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street, upstream of the crosswalk.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a refuge island, increasing exposure time to moving vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Foreground crosswalk spanning the width of the street.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before vehicles receive a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features wide multi-lane roadways with marked zebra crosswalks and pedestrian signals. While basic infrastructure is present, the significant crossing distance and lack of refuge islands increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic, increasing exposure time.

hazards.name: Lack of refuge
hazards.description: No physical protection or waiting area is provided in the center of the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island to provide a safe waiting area and break up the crossing distance.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Shorten the crossing distance by extending the sidewalk at the corners.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane intersection with a long, unprotected pedestrian crossing. While a marked crosswalk and pedestrian signals are present, the expansive asphalt and lack of refuge islands create a high-exposure environment. The open geometry and wide turning radii likely encourage higher vehicle speeds through the crossing area.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The pedestrian must cross a very wide expanse of asphalt without any mid-point refuge, increasing exposure time to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Wide Curb Radii
hazards.description: The open geometry allows vehicles to make turns at higher speeds, increasing the risk of high-impact collisions.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the intersection where the road curves.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised island in the center of the crossing to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The image shows a wide, multi-lane intersection with a long pedestrian crossing distance across a high-speed roadway. While zebra-marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals are present, the lack of a median refuge and the expansive road geometry create a hostile environment for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Long crossing distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for an extended period without a mid-point refuge.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the center of the roadway

hazards.name: High-speed design
hazards.description: The wide, open roadway and lack of traffic calming measures encourage high vehicle speeds.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median or island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross in stages.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the roadway at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reconfigure the roadway to reduce lane widths or the number of lanes, repurposing space for safety improvements.
